AIOSTREAMS_MANIFEST_URL.description: Paste your own configured AIOStreams manifest URL, or configure one or more direct sources below.

HIGHFLY_MANIFEST_URL.description: Optional direct HighFly Sports manifest URL.

API_SPORTS_KEY.description: Optional API-Sports dashboard key for supported soccer, basketball, hockey, and rugby schedules.

THESPORTSDB_API_KEY.description: Optional TheSportsDB key for fixture metadata.

SPORTHUB_CATALOGS.description: Optional. Leave blank for standard catalogs, or paste the catalog list from the SportsHub setup wizard.

SPORTHUB_STREAM_LANGUAGES.description: Optional. Leave blank for English preferred, or paste the language setting from the SportsHub wizard.
